data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order with the right parameters (open Planned Service Changes, search the route, select it, pick the date), but it treats the date picker as always required when it is only needed sometimes, and it doesn't name the actual 'Planned Work' link, so building the automation would take a little interpretation.
